title: [spec-gap][R-X509-052/054] Role-assertion trust scope: roles honored only from role-granting trust anchors
description: spec/appendix-x509-cert-profile.md section 8 role-assertion trust scope and section 5: the mesh role extension MUST be honored only when the chain validates to a trust anchor the deployment separately configured as authorized to grant roles; chains to any other anchor (including the optional public default CA of 06-security 8.13) establish key-to-address binding only and MUST NOT be read as asserting any role; when honored, a relay-role assertion satisfies a lichen:relay=true requirement without contacting the gateway, unless the deployment requires the short-lived COSE local-fact form. Classification: not-implemented (depends on chain validation bead + role extension bead; anchor authorization config does not exist). Suggested placement: credential verifier authorization layer per stack (bedw consumers); python TrustAnchorStore metadata field could carry the role-granting flag.
